summary: Cresco Labs filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements, MD&A and a news release for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, ownership change or corporate action is disclosed. Balance sheet items include $41.2M cash, $453.6M long-term notes and loans payable, and 361.1M subordinate voting shares outstanding versus 343.2M at year-end 2025. This is an ordinary quarterly earnings filing mapped to a US equivalent Form 8-K/10-Q, not a special situation; monitor for future M&A or capital actions.
